## Files Available on GitHub

The following `.xlsx` files are available in the [extdata folder](https://github.com/vcjdeboer/seahtrue/tree/develop-gerwin/inst/extdata):

```{=html}
<ul id="github-file-list">Loading…</ul>

<script>
const fileList = document.getElementById("github-file-list");
const apiUrl = "https://api.github.com/repos/vcjdeboer/seahtrue/contents/inst/extdata?ref=develop-gerwin";

fetch(apiUrl)
  .then(response => response.json())
  .then(data => {
    fileList.innerHTML = "";
    const xlsxFiles = data.filter(file => file.name.endsWith(".xlsx"));

    if (xlsxFiles.length === 0) {
      fileList.innerHTML = "<li>No .xlsx files found.</li>";
      return;
    }

    xlsxFiles.forEach(file => {
      const li = document.createElement("li");

      // Display plain filename
      const nameSpan = document.createElement("span");
      nameSpan.textContent = file.name;
      nameSpan.style.fontFamily = "monospace";
      li.appendChild(nameSpan);

      // Add copy button
      const copyBtn = document.createElement("button");
      copyBtn.textContent = "📋 Copy";
      copyBtn.style.marginLeft = "10px";
      copyBtn.onclick = async () => {
        try {
          await navigator.clipboard.writeText(file.name);
          copyBtn.textContent = "✅ Copied!";
          setTimeout(() => copyBtn.textContent = "📋 Copy", 1500);
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Copy failed", err);
          copyBtn.textContent = "❌ Failed";
        }
      };
      li.appendChild(copyBtn);

      fileList.appendChild(li);
    });
  })
  .catch(error => {
    console.error("Failed to load GitHub file list:", error);
    fileList.innerHTML = "<li>❌ Failed to load file list.</li>";
  });
</script>
```


```{webr-r}
# 🔧 USER: Set the exact file name here (must match GitHub!)
filename <- "20200110_SciRep_PBMCs_donor_C.xlsx"

# 📂 GitHub folder (keep unchanged unless moving files)
github_folder <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vcjdeboer/seahtrue/develop-gerwin/inst/extdata/"
)

# 🔗 Construct full download URL
url <- paste0(github_folder, filename)

# 💾 Download file into webr-r virtual filesystem
download.file(
  url, 
  destfile = filename,
  mode = "wb"
)

# 🧪 Load the file using seahtrue
seahtrue_output <- filename |>
  seahtrue::revive_xfplate()

# 👀 Inspect structure
seahtrue_output |> 
  dplyr::glimpse()


```

## Plot the plate layout


```{webr-r}

seahtrue_output %>% 
  pluck("raw_data", 1) %>% 
  seahtrue::sketch_plate(reorder_legend = TRUE)

```


## Plot the rate data

```{webr-r}

seahtrue_output %>% 
  purrr::pluck("rate_data", 1) |>
  sketch_rate(
         param = "OCR",
         normalize = FALSE,
         take_group_mean = TRUE,
         reorder_legend = TRUE
     )

```

## Plot the raw data histogram

```{webr-r}

seahtrue_output %>% 
  sketch_assimilate_raw(param = "O2_mmHg")

seahtrue_output %>% 
  sketch_assimilate_raw(param = "pH")

```
## Plot the measurement rate data


```{webr-r}

seahtrue_output %>% 
         sketch_assimilate_rate(
             param = "OCR",
             my_measurements = c(3, 4, 9, 12)
       )

```


## Plot the space plot

```{webr-r}
# first check out the exact group names

seahtrue_output |>
  pluck("rate_data", 1) |>
  pull(group) |> unique()

```

```{webr-r}
# default parameter assignement for a mito stress test

param_set_ocr <- c(
  init_ocr = "m3", 
  om_ocr = "m6", 
  fccp_ocr = "m7",
  amrot_ocr = "m12")

param_set_ecar <- c(
  init_ocr = "m3", 
  om_ocr = "m6", 
  fccp_ocr = "m7",
  amrot_ocr = "m12")

```

```{webr-r}


# 🔧 STEP 1: Set the groups to include (max 4 recommended)
selected_groups <- c("200.000", "300.000")

# 🔧 STEP 2: Provide injection parameters (keep naming consistent)
param_set_ocr <- c(
  init_ocr = "m3", 
  fccp_ocr = "m4", 
  amrot_ocr = "m9", 
  mon_ocr = "m12"
)

param_set_ecar <- c(
  init_ecar = "m3", 
  fccp_ecar = "m4", 
  amrot_ecar = "m9", 
  mon_ecar = "m12"
)

# 🧪 STEP 3: Create the space plot input data
df_space_user <- seahtrue_output |>
  pluck("rate_data", 1) |>
  filter(group %in% selected_groups) |>
  seahtrue::calculate_space(
    param_set_ocr = param_set_ocr,
    param_set_ecar = param_set_ecar
  ) 
# 📊 STEP 4: Plot the space plot
seahtrue::plot_bioenergetic_space(df_space_user)


```
